issue.title: sase agent restart cannot find crash-killed agents without done marker
issue.description:
## Bug
- **Location:** find_named_agent (agent lookup skips non-done records whose PID is dead)
sase agent restart <name> cannot find agents that died without a done marker, even though the TUI lists them as FAILED with Runner exited without recording an error. Cause per recovery triage: find_named_agent skips non-done records whose PID is dead.
Repro: kill a waiter agent process without done.json, observe TUI FAILED, run sase agent restart <name>, observe not-found. Affects 27 waiters on 2026-11-01 (16 land + 11 phase waiters).
Impact: host-restart recovery cannot use restart; requires manual sase bead work per epic.
